reviews.text: Our family is forever clever now that we've been shown the way. Thank you MCC and CG!

It truly may be impossible to recommend Caz and MCC highly enough.

As first-time dog owners, we found ourselves overwhelmed and unsure until we found Caz. She gave our dog the skills he needed to succeed, and she worked with us so that we could develop the skills and knowledge to be more effective dog parents. Our lives would be completely different now if not for Caz's skill, kindness, patience, and generosity. Caz cares deeply about the dogs she trains and about the people who care for them - we cannot recommend working with her enough. We adore Caz and are forever grateful for what she's done for our dog and for us.
